<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"> <sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <abort_action>false</abort_action> <access>package_private</access> <action_delete>false</action_delete> <action_insert>true</action_insert> <action_query>false</action_query> <action_update>true</action_update> <active>true</active> <add_message>false</add_message> <advanced>true</advanced> <change_fields>false</change_fields> <client_callable>false</client_callable> <collection>x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock</collection> <condition/> <description/> <execute_function>false</execute_function> <filter_condition/> <is_rest>false</is_rest> <message/> <name>Calculate Available Qty and Validate Sto</name> <order>100</order> <priority>100</priority> <rest_method/> <rest_method_text/> <rest_service/> <rest_service_text/> <rest_variables/> <role_conditions/> <script><![CDATA[/** * Before-save logic for Inventory Stock records. * * 1. Validates that Reserved Quantity never exceeds Total Quantity. * 2. Calculates Available Quantity = Total Quantity - Reserved Quantity. * 3. Sets Last Updated to the current date/time. */ (function executeRule(current, previous) { var totalQty = parseFloat(current.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0; var reservedQty = parseFloat(current.getValue('reserved_quantity')) || 0;
// Validate: Reserved Quantity must never exceed Total Quantity if (reservedQty > totalQty) { gs.addErrorMessage( 'Reserved Quantity (' + reservedQty + ') cannot be greater than Total Quantity (' + totalQty + ').' ); current.setAbortAction(true); return; }
// Calculate Available Quantity var availableQty = totalQty - reservedQty; current.setValue('available_quantity', availableQty.toString());
// Set Last Updated to current date/time var now = new GlideDateTime(); current.setValue('last_updated', now.getValue()); })(current, previous); ]]></script> <sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name> <sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by> <sys_created_on>2026-09-14 03:11:04</sys_created_on> <sys_domain>global</sys_domain> <sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path> <sys_id>070af6032f4b46eeaad06987784adcf5</sys_id> <sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count> <sys_name>Calculate Available Qty and Validate Sto</sys_name> <sys_overrides/> <sys_package display_value="Industrial Inventory and Production Management" source="x_2056099_indust_0">3cdb727d839b4b105e2cc430ceaad338</sys_package> <sys_policy/> <sys_scope display_value="Industrial Inventory and Production Management">3cdb727d839b4b105e2cc430ceaad338</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_script_070af6032f4b46eeaad06987784adcf5</sys_update_name> <sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by> <sys_updated_on>2026-09-14 03:11:04</sys_updated_on> <template/> <when>before</when> </sys_script> <sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=070af6032f4b46eeaad06987784adcf5"/> </record_update>
